claude.performance_metric: divested 80.1% of Chrysler for $7.4bn after ~108 months
claude.rationale: gap_45=1: T4 (Chrysler product lines Chrysler/Dodge/Jeep/Plymouth) transferred whole (§2 T4) but the operational processes (§2 T5) largely stayed separate and were not integrated, a documented product-vs-process mismatch at closing. gap_56=1: processes stayed separate/were resisted while the organization saw a management purge and cultural clash (§2 T5, T6), a process-vs-organization mismatch. p4_pathway=1: §4 P4 documents planned platform-sharing between Chrysler product lines and Daimler manufacturing was resisted and not implemented. p5_pathway=1: §4 P5 documents the Stallkamp ouster and culture clash accompanying the failure to integrate operations.

gemini.performance_metric: divested 80.1% stake after ~108 months for $7.4 billion
gemini.rationale: gap_45 is coded 0 because Chrysler's product lines and operational processes both transferred whole and remained together at closing. gap_56 is coded 1 because operations transferred fully while the organization experienced a partial transfer with a US management purge. p4_pathway is coded 1 due to documented resistance to planned platform-sharing between Chrysler products and Daimler manufacturing. p5_pathway is coded 1 because the management purge and culture clash fractured the integration of operations.

grok.rationale: gap_45=1 and p4_pathway=1 from T4 (product lines transferred whole) vs T5 (platform-sharing resisted, processes stayed separate) in section 2 and P4 evidence in section 4. gap_56=1 and p5_pathway=1 from T5 (operations not integrated) vs T6 (Stallkamp purge, culture clash) in section 2 and P5 evidence in section 4. T1 replace and t1_archetype=1 from Schrempp takeover admission in section 2; t2_model=1 from volume vs premium separation in section 4.
